[package]
name = "cxx-kde-frameworks"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
links = "cxx-kde-frameworks"

[dependencies]
cxx = "1.0.192"
cxx-qt = "0.10.0"

[dependencies.cxx-qt-lib]
version = "0.10.0"
features = ["qt_gui", "qt_qml", "qt_quickcontrols"]

[dependencies.cxx-qt-lib-extras]
version = "0.10.0"

[build-dependencies]
cmake-package = "0.3.1"

[build-dependencies.cxx-qt-build]
version = "0.10.0"
